description: When calculated_current is present, use its text_ar for current monetary amounts and cite its authority.url. Identify this as calculated under the authority, never as verbatim published wording. The article text_ar and source fields remain published wording. Get the verbatim texts of a law's articles in order, a page at a time: for each article its number, section_id, note, and the same text fields as get_article (text_ar in force today, text_fr, centre_text_ar when an amendment replaced the wording, version, repealed). Follow next_offset until it is absent to read the whole law. Amendment history stays in get_article. Not legal advice.

offset.description: how many articles to skip (next_offset of the previous page)

name: get_law_texts
